verdict.rationale: Serving LoRA adapters is a fair question for a local inference server like LocalAI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions LoRA adapters, adapter loading, or multi-adapter serving on a shared base model. Model aliasing, the model gallery and distributed nodes are adjacent features and do not deliver this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can efficiently serve multiple LoRA adapters on top of a base model
